summary: Garden Stage Limited, a Hong Kong-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing the resignations of independent directors Mr. Sheung Chi Steven Wu (effective September 22, 2026) and Mr. Kevin Guan (effective October 1, 2026), both accepted by the Board the same day. The Board appointed Mr. Ong Chor Wei Alan and Mr. Cheung Yick Hung Jackie as replacement independent directors, with committee chairs assigned and annual cash compensation of $18,000 each plus indemnity agreements. No premium, stake, or deal terms apply; the event is a board-level governance change. Watch for further abrupt departures or disclosure-control concerns given the near-simultaneous exits.
